articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved chain-of-thought reasoning, native image and audio generation, and a context window exceeding 1 million tokens. The model demonstrates substantial gains on graduate-level science benchmarks and complex agentic coding tasks, narrowing the gap between AI assistants and domain experts in fields like materials science and legal analysis.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Ultra Tops Agentic Benchmarks with Real-World Tool Use
articles.summary: DeepMind released Gemini 2.5 Ultra, which achieves state-of-the-art performance on agentic benchmarks involving multi-step web browsing, code execution, and API orchestration. The model introduces a refined mixture-of-experts architecture that reduces inference costs by approximately 40% compared to its predecessor while improving reliability on long-horizon planning tasks.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude's Computer Use 2.0 with Enterprise-Grade Autonomous Workflows
articles.summary: Anthropic expanded Claude's computer use capabilities with a major update enabling sustained autonomous desktop and browser workflows lasting hours with built-in checkpoint and rollback mechanisms. Targeted at enterprise IT automation and QA testing, the system includes enhanced safety guardrails such as human-in-the-loop confirmation for irreversible actions and comprehensive audit logging.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Unveils Commercial Atlas Electric Robot for Warehouse Logistics
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics began shipping its first commercial electric Atlas humanoid robots to select logistics partners including DHL and Amazon. The robot features improved whole-body manipulation, enabling it to handle irregularly shaped packages up to 25 kg, and operates autonomously for up to 6-hour shifts with a new hot-swappable battery system.

articles.title: Figure and BMW Expand Humanoid Robot Deployment Across Three Additional Manufacturing Plants
articles.summary: Figure Inc. announced the expansion of its partnership with BMW, deploying its Figure 02 humanoid robots at three new European manufacturing facilities following a successful pilot in Spartanburg, South Carolina. The robots now handle over 20 distinct assembly-line tasks including parts inspection and bin picking, with BMW reporting a 15% throughput improvement in deployed cells.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 2nm Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC commenced high-volume manufacturing on its N2 process technology, which uses gate-all-around (GAA) nanosheet transistors for the first time in the company's history. The node delivers approximately 15% speed improvement at the same power or 30% power reduction at the same speed compared to N3E, with Apple and NVIDIA among the first customers expected to tape out designs.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Approval for Expanded Brain-Computer Interface Trials in Motor Disorders
articles.summary: The FDA granted Neuralink approval to expand its PRIME clinical study to include patients with ALS and severe spinal cord injuries, allowing up to 50 new participants. Early data from existing trial participants showed the N1 implant maintaining stable signal quality over 18 months, with patients achieving cursor control speeds approaching those of able-bodied trackpad users.

articles.title: Meta Releases Open-Source Llama 4 Behemoth with 2 Trillion Parameters Under Permissive License
articles.summary: Meta released the full Llama 4 Behemoth model, a 2-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model, under a permissive open-source license that allows commercial use. Benchmarks show it matching or exceeding proprietary frontier models on reasoning and code generation tasks, and Meta simultaneously released optimized quantized variants that can run inference on a single 8×H100 node.
